title: Writing the Schema Bridge spec, draft 1

blocks.text: Let Balcony App inspections flow into Montague's Mesh Routing without anyone re-keying data. One shared format for an inspection record, one bridge that moves records from Balcony to Mesh Routing. Pilot customer: Ducal Freight.
site_id: which site the inspection happened at
photos: list of photo references, in order taken
findings: list of findings, each with a severity and a note
signed_at: when the inspector signed the report
Balcony to Mesh Routing, one direction for now. Nightly batch: every signed inspection from the day goes over in one run.
Who owns field versioning? If we add a field, who approves it?
What if Mesh Routing is down? (Tybalt's question, raise at kickoff)
